canonical_statement: For a closed planar region whose frontier is a finite union of closed analytic curves, positive constant density, potential force, prescribed pressure normalization, and Lebesgue-integrable vorticity satisfying Wolibner's decay, Holder-continuity, and zero interior-boundary-circulation hypotheses, for every finite T > 0 there exists a unique five-function motion satisfying conditions (I)-(VIII) of Wolibner (1933) on 0 <= t <= T.
domain_and_universes: Point = Real x Real; SourceDomain and SourceData are universe-zero structures; terminal time T and density are Real; the target is Prop.
ordered_binders: D.domain is a closed planar region
the domain boundary is a finite union of closed analytic curves
the vorticity is Lebesgue integrable on the domain
the vorticity satisfies source equation (1)'s decay condition
the vorticity is Holder continuous as in source equation (3)
initial circulation on every interior boundary component is zero
hypotheses: a fixed potential force and pressure normalization
source domain and vorticity assumptions above
conditions (I)-(VIII) define area preservation, momentum/Euler equations, initial values, normalization, circulation, decay, and spatial regularity
conclusion: There exists a five-function Motion D T, and every other Motion D T has equal Lagrangian coordinates, velocity components, and pressure.
encoding_boundary: The pinned snapshot has no classical incompressible-Euler API or analytic planar-boundary API matching the 1933 formulation. Source conditions (I)-(VIII) are therefore typed proposition fields, not invented modern whole-plane equations. They contain no existence or uniqueness conclusion. Expansion into native analytic definitions is proof-phase infrastructure debt and requires checked transports.

alternate_encodings.one_motion_on_nonnegative_infinite_time: Uncredited: the source constructs a solution for every arbitrary finite T; no compatibility transport to one function on [0, infinity) is supplied.
alternate_encodings.modern_velocity_pressure_euler_pde: Uncredited: no checked equivalence from source conditions (I)-(VIII) to a modern function-space formulation is supplied.

degenerate_and_boundary_cases: T is Real and strictly positive. T = 0 and negative T are excluded. Bounded and exterior source regions are retained; whole-plane or torus replacement is forbidden. Uniqueness is included because section 5 (pages 725-726) proves uniqueness under the same conditions.
